title: Quietly Adventurous Vietnamese Chicken Ca Kho To
description: This dish features tender chicken cooked in a flavorful panang curry paste sauce, served in a cataplana vessel and made with a lamination puff crust, making it a unique and adventurous Vietnamese meal.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Roll out the lamination puff pastry on a lightly floured surface to a large rectangle.
In a large bowl, whisk together the panang curry paste, coconut milk, fish sauce, and palm sugar.
Add the chicken thighs to the bowl and toss to coat with the curry sauce.
Place the chicken thighs in the center of the pastry rectangle, leaving a 1 inch border around the chicken.
Brush the edges of the pastry with the vegetable oil.
Fold the pastry over the chicken, pressing the edges to seal.
Place the cataplana vessel over the pastry and bake for 35 minutes.
Remove the cataplana vessel and sprinkle the chopped scallions over the top of the pastry.
Return the dish to the oven and bake for an additional 10 minutes, or until the pastry is golden brown.
